statements.notes:
Bluebonnet's micronized creatine powder
Delivers 5 grams of micronized creatine monohydrate to help support adenosine triphosphate (ATP) recycling in the muscle for more explosive and intense power and strength. Using creatine over time, combined with exercise, can help maintain existing muscle tissue and support lean muscle growth, development, and recovery.
When mixed in water, micronized creatine monohydrate dissolves quickly and is easy to use.

To assure freshness and potency, store in a cool, dry place away from heat, light and moisture.
Note: This product is sold by weight, not volume. Therefore, settling of contents may occur during shipment. The weight and servings are clearly marked.

Caution: For adults only
Keep out of reach of children.

Strength & Power
Support:
Muscle growth 
Lean muscle mass 
Recovery 
Easy-to-mix unflavored powder
Directions: As a dietary supplement, add one scoop (5 g) to 8 fl oz of water, juice, favorite smoothie or as directed by a healthcare practitioner. Mixes instantly without the use of a blender.
Store tightly closed in a cool, dry place. Scoop is enclosed.

Free of milk, egg, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame.
Also free of corn, gluten, barley, rice, sodium and sugar.
